summary: remove the hand-maintained last-updated lines and correct the stale layer paragraph in WORKFLOW.md
owner_direction:
Owner direction for a PROPHET change (2026-09-19). Two independent defects, both of
which are false statements in binding documents.

DEFECT 1 — A HAND-MAINTAINED DATE THAT ROTS.

Eight documents under docs/ carry a header line of the form `最后更新：YYYY-MM-DD`.
Four of them already state a date that is wrong: OPERATOR_CONTROL.md,
STRATEGY_ECONOMICS.md and ASSET_ADMISSION.md say 2026-09-14 and PROJECT_GOALS.md says
2026-09-16, while all four were modified on 2026-09-19. The line is maintained by hand,
nothing checks it, and Git already records the true answer.

Remove the `最后更新：...` line from every document under docs/ that carries one.
Leave the `状态：...` line above it, the blank line after it, and every other character
of each file untouched: this is a deletion of one line per file, not an editorial pass.

Do NOT touch the `date:` field in any ADR front matter. An ADR date is the date the
decision was taken and is immutable by design, which is a different thing from a
last-edited stamp.

Find the files yourself; the Manager counted eight under docs/. If your count differs,
your resolution wins and you record the difference in unresolved_questions.

DEFECT 2 — todo/WORKFLOW.md DOCUMENTS A LAYER THAT NO LONGER EXISTS.

The paragraph beginning `CONTRACT` permits only the named task contracts` states that
`SPEC` additionally permits docs/spec/ and spec_revision, and that `INTENT` additionally
permits docs/intent/ and intent_revision. `INTENT` is not in AMENDMENT_LAYERS: it was
replaced by `PROPHET` when that layer was added, and this paragraph was left behind.
The same paragraph also asserts that a passing amendment leaves the target tasks
`PLANNED` and that a retry starts a fresh `Planner`, neither of which holds for
SUPERSEDE (whose targets are APPROVED) or for PROPHET (which targets no task at all).

Rewrite that paragraph so it is true of the four layers that exist -- CONTRACT, SPEC,
PROPHET and SUPERSEDE. Read the layer definitions in tools/workflow/core.py
(`AMENDMENT_LAYERS` and the branches keyed on `record.layer`) and the PROPHET and
SUPERSEDE sections later in the same file, and describe what the code actually does
rather than what the old prose said. Keep it short: the detailed treatment already
lives in the PROPHET and SUPERSEDE sections.

DO NOT. Do not change any other part of todo/WORKFLOW.md, do not edit any task
contract, do not edit todo/config.yaml, do not touch tools/workflow/, .claude/,
todo/schemas/, .github/, src/ or tests/. Do not create, delete or rename a file. Do
not alter the `状态：` lines, and do not decide whether the general convention of a
header status line should survive -- record that as a question if you judge it worth
the Owner's attention.

RECORD. Every mutable fact you restate needs a source. No credential, API key or
environment value may appear. An earlier PROPHET change in this session wrote a false
figure by trusting the direction instead of the files; derive every count from the
repository and record any disagreement rather than reproducing it.
